title: Gumloop alternatives: AI agent builders | 50agents
description: Gumloop alternatives: Lindy for an AI assistant, Relevance AI for sales, n8n and Activepieces to self-host, and 50agents for browser agents, free to start.
answer: Lindy works in your inbox and calendar; Relevance AI focuses on sales.
n8n and Activepieces self-host. 50agents builds browser agents and AI agents from plain words, free to start.
line: Browser agents and AI agents from plain words, free to start.
ask: Set up a browser agent that checks my competitors' pricing pages every day at 9:00 and tells me when a price changes
lede: Other AI agent builders, and where each one starts.

strengths.title: Websites with no app
strengths.line: A browser agent reads sites on a schedule and leaves you a report.

faqs.q: Does Gumloop have a free plan?
faqs.a: No. Gumloop offers a 14-day Pro trial that needs a card. Pro is $37 a month for 20,000 credits.

faqs.q: Which Gumloop alternative has a browser agent?
faqs.a: Lindy can drive a browser on Pro and up. 50agents has browser agents that read and use websites with no app to connect.

faqs.q: Can I self-host a Gumloop alternative?
faqs.a: Yes. n8n and Activepieces both run on your own servers.
Lindy's Team plan starts at $29.99 a month for 3,000 credits. Relevance AI's Pro is $19 a month billed yearly. n8n Starter is €20 a month billed yearly. 50agents is free to start.

faqs.q: Can I move my Gumloop AI agents over?
faqs.a: There is no import. Note what each one does, then describe it to Captain, which shows a plan before it builds.
Relevance AI builds sales AI agent teams wired into Salesforce, HubSpot and Gong.

faqs.q: Which alternatives wait for approval first?
faqs.a: Lindy waits for your OK on outside actions. 50agents holds anything that reaches people outside your business until you say yes.
